title: Neon workspace
selectConnection: Select a Neon connection to continue.
noConnection: Open a saved Neon connection in the sidebar, then reopen this workspace to manage its services and credentials.
consoleBindingMissing: This connection has no valid Neon project or branch binding. Reconnect it or update Connection / Setup.
waiting: Waiting for a live snapshot… This can take up to 30 seconds.
overviewDescription: Services and connection details for this branch.
databaseDescription: Latest demo notes in this project.
storageDescription: Browse objects in the assets bucket.
deleteObjectConfirm: Permanently delete “{{key}}” from the assets bucket?
putObjectConfirm: Save “{{key}}” to the assets bucket? Existing content at this key will be replaced.
aiDescription: Choose an enabled model and try a prompt.
noModels: No enabled models returned. Check AI Gateway configuration in the Neon console.
aiCost: Uses AI Gateway credits. Response limited to 64 tokens.
functionsDescription: Call the configured hello function and inspect its response.
realtimeDescription: Read a live SQL snapshot or wait for a matching value.
realtimeHint: A single snapshot is returned within 30 seconds, then the subscription closes. For a target value, change a matching row in another SQL editor while this request waits.
snapshotComplete: Snapshot received. The subscription is now closed.
setupDescription: Store service access for this connection. Saved values remain hidden.
setupHint: Development .env files are not loaded automatically in Tabularis. Import the complete service credential bundle for this connection. Saving replaces all previously imported fields; omitted fields are removed.
noCredentials: No service credentials stored for this connection.
importLabel: Import .env lines or a JSON object
importPlaceholder: Paste credentials here. Values stay masked.
deleteCredentialsConfirm: Remove all imported service credentials for this connection from the keyring? You will need to import them again to use these services.
credentialsSaved: Credentials saved. The pasted draft has been cleared.
fieldsHint: SQL access comes from the saved Tabularis connection. Import matching service credentials for this branch. Manage projects and branches through your connected Neon account or CLI sign-in.

credentialErrors.empty: Paste at least one supported credential.
credentialErrors.syntax: Use KEY=value lines or a valid JSON object with string values.
credentialErrors.unsupported: The input contains an unsupported field. Check the supported credential names below.
credentialErrors.value: Each credential must contain a non-empty text value.
credentialErrors.duplicate: A credential appears more than once. Keep one value for each field.

coreRequired: This workspace requires the current Tabularis provider-workspace build.
storageEmpty: List the bucket to browse objects. Use the prefix to narrow the results.
textObjectsHint: Read an existing object or prepare text to save. Writes require confirmation.
aiEmpty: The model response will appear here after you send a prompt.
functionEmpty: Invoke the function to inspect its response.
realtimeEmpty: Run the query to inspect its current live result.
storedFieldsHint: Only field names are shown. Stored values cannot be read back.

account.title: Connect a Neon account
account.description: Connect your Neon account, then import an existing branch and its enabled services.
account.keyHint: Stored in the host secret store. The saved key cannot be read back by the UI.
account.createKey: Create an API key in Neon
account.noProjects: No projects are available in this scope. Select an organization or check your account permissions.
account.createCredentials: Create scoped credentials for enabled Storage and AI Gateway services
account.credentialsHint: Creates new service credentials on the selected branch. Existing services are discovered without enabling, deploying, rotating, or deleting anything. Without this option, these services may require a later credential import.
account.importedHint: The connection is now available in Connections. Open it to access its Neon services in the explorer.

cli.title: Neon CLI · Recommended
cli.description: Use the Neon CLI to sign in with your browser. No API key to paste.
cli.hostHint: The CLI runs on the machine hosting Tabularis. In the web version, install and sign in on the Tabularis server, not your local browser device.
cli.notInstalled: Neon CLI is not installed or could not be found on the Tabularis host.
cli.installHint: Run this command yourself on the Tabularis host with Node.js and npm installed, then recheck the CLI. Tabularis will not install or upgrade software for you.
cli.copyFailed: Could not copy the command. Select and copy it manually.
cli.finishSignIn: Finish signing in in your browser. This window will continue automatically. If the browser is on another machine, use an API key instead.
cli.detectFailed: Could not check the Neon CLI. Recheck it on the Tabularis host or use an API key.
cli.connectFailed: Could not connect this account or access the project. Check your Neon permissions, retry, or use an API key.
cli.loginFailed: Neon CLI sign-in failed. Recheck the CLI on the Tabularis host and retry, or use an API key.
cli.timeout: Neon CLI sign-in timed out. Start sign-in again or use an API key.
cli.browserFailed: Could not open your browser. Try reopening the sign-in page or use an API key.
cli.unsupportedVersion: Update the CLI to Neon 8.15.1 or a newer 8.x release, then recheck.
cli.keyringProfile: The current CLI profile uses the OS keyring and cannot be reused here. Sign in to a separate Tabularis CLI profile or use an API key.
cli.signedOut: No reusable CLI sign-in was found. Sign in with the CLI or use an API key.
cli.unavailableProfile: The CLI profile could not be checked. Retry or use an API key.
cli.profileStorageHint: New browser sign-in creates a separate file-backed Tabularis CLI profile. Existing CLI profiles stay unchanged. Disconnecting Tabularis does not sign the CLI out.

authManager.description: Inspect users on this connection. Account access is required for management actions.
authManager.accountRequired: Connect a Neon account with permission for this project and branch to manage users. Read-only inspection remains available.
authManager.createHint: Creates an Auth identity using the management API. No password is set here; the user completes authentication or password recovery through your application.
authManager.name: Name
authManager.profileReadOnly: Profile fields are read-only because the management API does not expose profile updates. Roles can be changed below.
authManager.sessionsReadOnly: Session metadata is read-only. Session revocation and password-reset actions require an Auth admin session and are not available through this account API.
authManager.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this user from the selected branch? This can affect application data linked to this identity.

functionsManager.accountRequired: Connect a Neon account and select a project branch to manage Functions.
functionsManager.description: Deployed functions on this branch. Open a function to edit, configure, invoke or inspect it.
functionsManager.empty: No functions have been deployed on this branch.
functionsManager.createDescription: Create a function on this branch.
functionsManager.editDescription: Manage this function on the selected branch. Refresh to check an asynchronous deployment.
functionsManager.slugHint: 1–20 lowercase letters or digits. Permanent URL identifier.
functionsManager.sourceHint: Default-export a request handler or an object with fetch(request).
functionsManager.sourceUnavailable: Neon does not return the deployed source. Paste your local source to replace this function; the existing code stays unchanged until you confirm deployment.
functionsManager.sessionDraftHint: Draft kept while switching tabs. Save a local copy before restarting.
functionsManager.replaceWarning: Replace the deployed source of {{slug}} on this branch? The previous code may stop serving while the new deployment starts.
functionsManager.deploymentStarted: Deployment accepted: {{status}}. Refresh to check the current state.
functionsManager.environmentHint: Existing values stay hidden. Submit a JSON object with only changed keys; use null to remove a key. Unmentioned keys remain unchanged.
functionsManager.invalidEnvironment: Enter a JSON object containing valid environment names with non-empty strings or null, up to 64 keys and 24 KiB.
functionsManager.newEnvironmentHint: These changes will be included in the first deployment.
functionsManager.environmentSaved: Environment update accepted. Existing values stay hidden and the input has been cleared.
functionsManager.invokeHint: Send a request to this function's deployed endpoint. Your Neon account key is never forwarded to the function.
functionsManager.logsUnavailable: Logs are not available through the current management API.
functionsManager.deleteWarning: Delete {{slug}} and its deployed endpoint from this branch? This cannot be undone.
functionsManager.activationWarning: After updating, invoke the function to verify the result. In this environment, Neon has sometimes continued serving the previous revision.

management.missingBinding: Save the Neon project and branch in Connection / Setup before managing services.
management.connectRequired: Connect a Neon account with permission for this project to manage services.
management.branchMissing: The saved branch could not be found in this project.

connectionSetup.title: Connect your Neon workspace
connectionSetup.description: Choose your Neon project and branch, then manage its backend services directly in Tabularis. For a standalone PostgreSQL URL, use the PostgreSQL plugin.
connectionSetup.manageHint: Open this connection to manage its Neon services in the explorer. Use a new Neon connection for another branch; appearance and connection metadata can be edited here.
connectionSetup.legacyHint: This older connection has no complete Neon project binding. Add it again through the Neon project picker to attach its services.
connectionSetup.accountStored: Neon account credentials are stored securely. Service actions check access to this project.

databaseNativeHint: Browse tables and run SQL in the normal Tabularis explorer and console. The former Neon demo-data tab has been retired.
databaseNativeHintShort: Tables and SQL in the native explorer

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: Manage the branches of this connection’s Neon project.
branches.name: Branch name
branches.copyHint: Copies schema and data from the selected parent branch.
branches.deleteBlocked: Current, default, protected, parent and locally connected branches cannot be deleted here. Remove their saved connections first.
branches.deleteHint: Deleting this branch permanently removes its data and branch services.
branches.isolationHint: Each branch uses a separate connection. Existing SQL tabs and drafts stay on their original branch.
branches.unresolved: Some local connection bindings could not be read. Refresh or repair those connections before deleting a branch.

usage.title: Usage & limits
usage.accountRequired: Connect a Neon account to read this project’s usage and limits. CLI sign-in and API keys are supported.
usage.scopeMismatch: The usage response did not match this connection. Refresh to try again.
usage.warning: Approaching the returned limit (80% or more).
usage.quotaHint: These are enforcement ceilings, not plan-included allowances; usage can incur charges before a cap is reached. Current control-plane counters may lag and are not invoice totals. Project quotas can suspend computes; branch size quotas can block writes. Missing quotas remain unknown.
usage.historyHint: Reported v2 consumption for completed UTC intervals. This may lag live activity. Storage here is accumulated GB-months, not the current branch size. Missing metrics in returned samples are documented zeros; missing samples are not.
usage.partial: Incomplete intervals or older history excluded
usage.noData: No consumption samples returned for this period.
usage.budgetHint: This limit belongs to the whole organization and is notification-only. Neon sends notifications at 80% and 100%; reaching it does not stop usage. No billing settings are changed here.
usage.currencyHint: The endpoint returns cents without a currency code. Confirm the currency in the Neon Console.
usage.invoiceUnavailable: Invoice totals and remaining budget are unavailable here. Check the Neon Console for billing amounts.
usage.coverageHint: Plan-included allowances, Auth active-user quotas, Object Storage usage/quotas, AI Gateway credit balances and Realtime quotas are not supplied by the APIs used here. Check the Neon Console. Snapshot storage and extra-branch meters are project-only.

reasons.access_or_plan: Not available for this plan or these account permissions.
reasons.unsupported: This endpoint is unavailable for this account.
reasons.request_failed: Neon could not return these values. Refresh to retry.
reasons.organization_missing: The API did not return an organization for this project.
reasons.period_missing: No complete reporting interval or valid consumption period is available.
reasons.invalid_response: The API returned incomplete or inconsistent usage data.
